ExcelProcessor.read_excel:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an Excel file and returns a list of row values from the active sheet, returning None if any exception occurs." read_excel]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: string "Path to the Excel file to load and read."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: list or None "List of row tuples from the active sheet when successful; None when any exception occurs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list and assign it to data. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, load the Excel workbook from file_name using openpyxl.load_workbook. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, get the active sheet from workbook. RESULT sheet]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, for each row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True), append row to data. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, close the workbook. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, return data. RESULT data]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If any exception occurs inside the try block during loading the workbook, retrieving the active sheet, iterating rows and appending to data, or closing the workbook, skip the remaining normal steps and execute the except block.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ExcelProcessor.write_excel:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Write rows from data into a new Excel workbook and save it to file_name, returning 1 on success and 0 on any failure." write_excel]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: Iterable[Iterable] "Rows to append to the Excel sheet."
        <REF> file_name </REF>: str "Path or filename used to save the workbook."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "1 if the workbook is created and saved successfully, otherwise 0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, create a new openpyxl Workbook object. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, get the active worksheet from workbook. RESULT sheet]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, for each row in data, append row to sheet. RESULT sheet]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, save the workbook to file_name. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, close the workbook. RESULT workbook]
            [COMMAND Within the try block, return 1. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: An exception is raised inside the try block.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ExcelProcessor.process_excel_data:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads an Excel file, appends an uppercased string transformation of column N when its string form is not all digits, writes the modified rows to a new processed Excel file, and returns the write success plus the new filename." process_excel_data]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> N </REF>: int "Column index used to select the value to transform and append."
        <REF> save_file_name </REF>: string "Input Excel filename; its prefix before the first dot is used to build the output filename."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> success </REF>: any "Return value from write_excel for the newly written processed file."
        <REF> new_file_name </REF>: string "Generated output filename consisting of the input filename prefix before the first dot plus '_process.xlsx'."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.read_excel(save_file_name) and store the returned value in data. RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Initialize new_data to an empty list. RESULT new_data]
            [COMMAND For each row in data, create new_row as a copy of row; if str(row[N]) is not composed entirely of digit characters, append str(row[N]).upper() to new_row, otherwise append row[N] unchanged; then append new_row to new_data. RESULT new_data]
            [COMMAND Build new_file_name by splitting save_file_name on '.' and taking the first part, then appending '_process.xlsx'. RESULT new_file_name]
            [COMMAND Call self.write_excel(new_data, new_file_name) and store the returned value in success. RESULT success]
            [COMMAND Return success and new_file_name. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If data is None, or if data is not None and N >= len(data[0]), the method returns 0 immediately.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0 immediately. RESULT early_return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
